image_description: A close-up, black-and-white photograph of a Rawlings baseball with selective color highlighting a yellow smiley face button attached to the bottom. The baseball features prominent red stitching (rendered in grayscale) and visible branding text 'Rawlings' and 'OFFICIAL MAJOR LEAGUE BASEBALL'. A signature 'Vince W.' is visible in the bottom right corner.

Despite the black-and-white filter, the high brightness value indicates a white cover.

artifact_observations.location: Stitching holes along the central seam
artifact_observations.reasoning: Several stitch holes appear elongated or fused rather than distinct punctures. The thread thickness varies inconsistently, suggesting AI generation struggles with the repetitive micro-structure of baseball stitching.

artifact_observations.location: Junction of smiley face button and baseball
artifact_observations.reasoning: The yellow button lacks a realistic pin mechanism or shadow casting onto the ball. It appears to float or merge with the surface without proper physical grounding or occlusion logic.
The script text resembling a signature is illegible and morphologically inconsistent with real handwriting, typical of AI-generated text artifacts.
Selective coloring (B&W with yellow spot) creates an unnatural aesthetic that may mask underlying texture inconsistencies in the leather grain.
